name: hypertask_time
does: Start, stop, pause or resume ticket timers, log minutes, inspect running timers and report time entries.
use_when: Use when the user asks to track work or summarize recorded time in a date range.
do_not_use_when: Do not use for estimates or due dates; use hypertask_tasks update instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. task_identifier accepts a numeric task id or ticket number; user_id accepts a numeric user id or me. log requires minutes; from/to select dates and timezone_offset_minutes controls date interpretation.
